notablePrerequisites:
Synth Infiltrator on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Synth Infiltrator do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Synth Infiltrator.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Synth Infiltrator.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
